description: The same for a 197-byte valid frame with an unknown key o.zz (padding '=', two spare bits; the higher one, 0x02, is set: an implementation that looks only at the lowest trailing bit accepts it). A decoder that only validates the alphabet counts the message AND reports FORCE_UNKNOWN_KEY. Under 2.2: UNDECODABLE, RAW_HASH_MISMATCH, MALFORMED, one void, slot NONE, no FORCE finding.
title: non-canonical trailing bits, padding '=' (a valid frame with an unknown key)
